pairs.why: A has a zipper slider, so the bag reads as a complete, properly built object; otherwise the two are nearly identical.
B has the slider and a cleaner, more solidly built zip; A's zip is a bare strip with a softer, hazier finish.
A's ring and zip are crisper with less washed-out glare, closer to the clean, saturated finish of the real cards, but the gap is small.
A's bolder ring and fuller bag volume match the chunky, readable objects on the real cards slightly better, but the two are almost the same.
A has the slider and a smoother background, while B has no slider and a grainy leather background that goes against the smoother finish the lessons prefer.
B has the slider and a smoother, stitched-pad background, while A has no slider and more surface grain.
A's zip is a saturated, solid blue like the real cards' clean colors, while B's zip is paler and glassier, but the difference is small.
B's slider sits neatly on the zip and its plastic finish is cleaner, while A's slider pokes past the edge, but the difference is small.
